events.t: hey thanks for making time today, how have things been on your side
busy honestly, we are losing about ten hours a week to manual reconciliation and it is burning out my team
that sounds painful, what is that actually costing you
each analyst wastes maybe twelve hours a month so it is roughly forty thousand dollars a quarter in lost productivity
got it, and if you brought something in who would need to approve that
our cfo dana signs off on anything over fifty thousand dollars so she would own the budget
makes sense, what would a solution need to do to be a fit
it has to integrate with netsuite and pass our soc two review, those are hard requirements for us
and how would a decision like this actually get made
we would pilot for a month then i take it to the exec team in q three for final approval
are you looking at any other options right now
we looked at workday but it was way too heavy for what we need honestly
if this checks out would you be the one championing it internally
yeah honestly i would push hard for this internally, i am the one feeling the pain every day
great, anything on the procurement side we should plan for
our legal review takes about three weeks and the security review another two weeks on top
